note: Escapees-run park (formerly Turkey Creek RV Village) in Hollister on the Turkey Creek arm of Lake Taneycomo, a mile from Branson Landing; also a covered-wagon rental. --Claude
summary: Operator + Staylist: $47 30A back-in (Nov 2026-Jan 2027, 2027 season not yet priced), 50A/w/s, pull-throughs, showers/laundry/dump/wifi, online booking. Under $50 before tax, and Branson is a gateway 2 km away anyway. Riverview kept: creek-arm pads look across their loop road and a 10-20 m bare-tree bank to the ~35-40 m impounded Turkey Creek.
flags: Price: cheapest RV night $47 plus tax (30A back-in), so with Missouri sales tax it may exceed $50; Branson gateway 2 km away (gateways.py) passes it either way. Google Maps 4.2 over 261 reviews (417-335-8004); RV Life 4* $$ over 156.

Waterfront: riverview kept, not upgraded. The west-loop pads face across the perimeter road and a 10-20 m wooded bank to the Turkey Creek arm, about 35-40 m wide at the park (backed up by Lake Taneycomo); the leaf-off frame shows the water through bare trees, a summer sightline is less certain. Borderline - downgrade to not waterfront if a leaf-on look shows no view.
Long-stay check passes: nightly sites bookable online at posted rates; the policies page's general-delivery mail and 'RV Living' wording point to many long-stay Escapees guests, not a resident park.
Site count 68 not stated by the operator; Staylist showed 65 bookable spaces across types on 2026-11-09 (38 + 13 + 8 + 5 dry camp + 1 wagon).
